text:
Priya: quick idea, want to float a 'grace credits' approach for fairness when noisy tenants spike. short summary: each org gets a tiny credit bucket that can absorb short bursts without harming low-traffic tenants. refill based on long-term commit.

Ezra: sounds promising — how does it differ from our current smoothing/penalty window? will it add more total capacity or just change allocation? :thinking:

Priya: it doesn't add capacity. it's a short-term buffer to avoid hard ejection for small bursts. main parts: per-org moving average usage (1h), a small credit bucket (tokens), and a soft-evict threshold that consults credits before ejecting. if credits empty -> fall back to penalty window.

Priya: config sketch:
```yaml
rate_limit:
  per_org:
    baseline_rps: 10
    credit_bucket:
      capacity: 50   # tokens
      refill_per_min: 5
      token_cost_per_req: 1
  soft_evict_margin: 0.15
```

Lena: nice. what telemetry do we need to tell if credits are working vs just masking a noisy neighbour problem?

Priya: good call. plan to emit metrics: `org_credit_level`, `org_credit_consumed_rate`, `soft_evict_count`, `hard_evict_count`, and `post_evict_latency_increase`. also histogram of request latencies pre/post eviction.

Lena: promql for the dashboard panel, rough draft:
```promql
sum by (org) (org_credit_level) / sum by (org) (org_credit_capacity)
```
panel: percent of bucket remaining across top 100 orgs, and a small table for orgs with >50 soft evicts in last 24h.

Marco: edge case: short very high qps spikes from large orgs could drain their bucket in seconds and then create churn. propose: allow bucket refill to temporarily increase during low-cluster-util windows (adaptive refill) OR implement a per-route micro-backoff (50ms) to smooth spikes.

Devon: rollout notes: feature-flagged. canary -> 5% orgs (exclude enterprise customers). console: expose "grace credits" panel and a toggle for ops to top up an org (manual override) for troubleshooting. schedule: PR + telemetry next week, canary 2 weeks after.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: feature-flag `grace-credits` created by @Priya, flag id gc-2026-03.

Ezra: we should also add automated alerting: if `soft_evict_count` / `hard_evict_count` > 0.1 for any org for 6h -> page on-call (sre) and create tidy ticket for product.

Priya: agreed. testing checklist: unit tests for token accounting, integ tests that simulate noisy neighbor with two orgs, and a chaos test that toggles refill rate. simple load test script for local validation:
```bash
# simulate spike from org A
for i in {1..1000}; do curl -s -H "x-api-key:ORG_A" http://localhost:8080/v1/generate & done
```

Marco: can we log samples when credit hits 0 with top-5 offending routes? that will help root cause.

Priya: yes, will add sampled debug logs (rate-limited) and a telemetry tag with route and model variant.

Devon: UX notes: in rollout we should show both absolute bucket and % capacity and an explanatory tooltip: "grace credits absorb short bursts; they do not increase your committed throughput." avoids support tickets.

Ezra: +1. also include an experiment key so we can A/B measure impact on tail latency and request success.

Priya: ok i'll open the design PR with config, promql, and canary plan. followups: Marco on sampling logs, Lena on dashboards, Ezra on alerts, Devon on console copy. thanks everyone :heart:
